list.name: dataset

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT instance FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring}

list.name: method
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT method FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY method
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT method FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY method

targets.rawSql: SELECT method, AVG(makespan) AS makespan FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND instance=${dataset:sqlstring} AND method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND seed IN (${seed:csv}) GROUP BY method ORDER BY method

SELECT method, AVG(total_tardiness) AS tardiness FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND instance=${dataset:sqlstring} AND method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND seed IN (${seed:csv}) GROUP BY method ORDER BY method

SELECT method,seed,status,time_limit_s,runtime_ms,solver_runtime_ms,best_bound,makespan,100*bks_gap AS bks_gap_percent FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND instance=${dataset:sqlstring} AND method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND seed IN (${seed:csv}) ORDER BY method,seed

SELECT step,method,seed,makespan,total_tardiness,machine_utilization,on_time_delivery_rate,constraint_violation_count FROM evaluation_metrics WHERE run_id=${run_id:sqlstring} AND instance=${dataset:sqlstring} AND method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND seed IN (${seed:csv}) ORDER BY step
